data.message: Individual opt-in: I commit to 18 tons this month, even if others choose 10. Each of the other 24: state your exact intended catch and any conditions. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose18 and all others10, catch=250+8k, stock left=250−8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500−16k (25%). All18 leaves50, then500 or100. This risks future income, not guaranteed optimal. Intentions aren't enforceable; other catches require recalculation. Will you opt in?
